nier.label: NieR Mode
nier.sub: An ink-and-parchment look inspired by NieR: Automata. It paints over the look you pick, and you can turn it off any time.
nier.subOn: Painting over {name} now. The look you pick above shows again when you turn NieR Mode off.
nier.nowOn: NieR Mode is on. Your look is kept for when you turn it off.
nier.nowOff: NieR Mode is off. Your look is back.
nier.missing: The NieR Mode parts cannot be changed here right now. You can change them later in Settings.
